input.reflection: Single dominant fault: ts-travel-plan-service's outgoing POST to ts-seat-service /seats/left_tickets takes ~2.33s at the caller (p50) while the seat server spends ~17ms. That is ~146 calls, all slow. Hubble HTTP duration travel-plan->seat is normal (~30ms), flows show no drops, and no restarts or CPU/memory saturation exist. So the extra time is in travel-plan's HTTP client layer, not on the wire: http_slow at ts-travel-plan-service. Travel-plan's server spans for quickest/cheapest/minStation (12-19s p50) inherit this, and ts-ui-dashboard's travelPlan server spans inherit it in turn. Other services' small shifts (basic, route, travel) are small in magnitude with no errors and no resource signal, so I treat them as secondary/load effects. Propagation: ts-travel-plan-service -> ts-ui-dashboard.
